migration.provisionalNote: Two halves, both still open. (1) FORM: the page now draws a real form (#58) — formSection, carrying Gravity Form 1's actual field set — but IT CANNOT SEND. #58 built the fields only; no submission mechanism and no destination have been decided, so the submit button is disabled and the form says so on the page. The mailto CTA in the reach band is still the only working conversion path. Cleared by #58's remaining halves: a handler (with a spam story) and somewhere for a submission to land. (2) COMPOSITION: no canonical Figma frame exists for /contact, so the section order and the form band's layout are assembled from existing parts rather than transcribed, and carry no figmaNode. The copy is the WordPress page's (wpId 158) plus the studio's published email, phone and address from the site chrome extract. Cleared by a commissioned contact frame.
